questions.prompt: Who was the first female prime minister of the United Kingdom?
questions.fact: She trained as a research chemist before entering law and then politics.

questions.prompt: Which element is represented by the symbol 'O'?
questions.fact: It is the most abundant element in the Earth's crust, mostly locked up in silicate rocks rather than the air.

questions.prompt: In which sport would you use a foil, epee, or sabre?
questions.fact: The three weapons differ in valid target area and in whether right of way applies.

questions.prompt: Which superhero comes from the planet Krypton?
questions.fact: He was created by two Cleveland teenagers who sold the rights for a hundred and thirty dollars.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Yucatan Peninsula?
questions.fact: The asteroid impact linked to the dinosaur extinction struck just off its northern coast.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character named Winston Smith?
questions.fact: The author wrote it while seriously ill on a remote Scottish island, typing the final draft himself in bed.

questions.prompt: Which unit describes a trillion bytes?
questions.fact: Drive makers count it as a power of ten while operating systems often use powers of two, which is why capacity appears to shrink.
